 export const askXataWithAi = async ({
   table,
   question,
   rules,
   searchType,

+  timeoutMs = 20000,
 }: {
   table: string;
   question: string;
   rules?: string[];
   searchType?: string;
   search?: any;
-  sessionId?: string;
+  sessionId?: string;
+  timeoutMs?: number;
 }) =&gt; {
   try {
-    const askOptions: any = {};
-    if (rules) askOptions.rules = rules;
+    const askOptions: any = {};
+    if (rules) askOptions.rules = Array.isArray(rules) ? rules : [rules];

+    const attempt = async () =&gt; {
+      // Implement a soft timeout using Promise.race; underlying request may continue but we fail fast
+      const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) =&gt; {
+        const id = setTimeout(() =&gt; {
+          clearTimeout(id);
+          const err: any = new Error("Xata ask() request timed out");
+          err.code = "FETCH_TIMEOUT";
+          reject(err);
+        }, Math.max(1000, timeoutMs));
+      });
+
+      return await Promise.race([
+        xataClient.db[table].ask(question, askOptions),
+        timeoutPromise,
+      ]) as any;
+    };
+
+    try {
+      const result = await attempt();
+      return result;
+    } catch (firstError: any) {
+      // Retry once for transient network errors or timeouts
+      const isTimeout = firstError?.code === 'FETCH_TIMEOUT' || firstError?.code === 'ETIMEDOUT';
+      const isNetwork = firstError?.name === 'TypeError' || firstError?.message?.includes('fetch failed');
+      if (isTimeout || isNetwork) {
+        // small backoff
+        await new Promise(r =&gt; setTimeout(r, 300));
+        const result = await attempt();
+        return result;
+      }
+      throw firstError;
+    }
   } catch (error) {
